## Interactive Companion App

An accompanying Shiny web application provides full access to the parsed and annotated transcriptomic results, enabling dynamic exploration across genotypes and time points.

🔗 Access the app: <https://vierakovacova.shinyapps.io/playing_with_immunity/>

The interface allows users to:

- Search for individual genes or immunity-related modules
- Visualize log₂ fold-change trajectories across infection stages
- Browse GO and Reactome enrichment results interactively
- Explore co-expression network structure and immunity layer annotations
- Export plots and tables for custom analyses

All datasets shown in the app are synchronized with this repository.
